name: Smart Line Namer
description:
Smart Line Namer adds two auto-rename schemes to the line manager, turning the game's default names like "Line 12" into names that actually describe each line.

Vehicle - Route — vehicle type + direction:
- Train: Gukovo — Chekalin (between towns)
- Bus Gukovo: Center — North (within a town, directions from the town center)
- Truck: Quarry — Factory (between industries)

Vehicle - Stops — vehicle type + first and last station:
- Train: Central — Riverside (between towns)
- Tram Gukovo: Factory — Park (within a town)

Vehicle types are detected automatically and are passenger/cargo aware: bus, truck, tram, train, cargo train, plane, cargo plane, ship and cargo ship. A station named after its own town is shown as "Station" ("Вокзал" in Russian) to keep the name readable.

How to use: create or select a line, open the auto-rename dialog (the wand button) and choose the Vehicle - Route or Vehicle - Stops scheme. The vanilla schemes remain available.

All names are localized — the mod ships with English and Russian translations.
